message: The other night, we had a sudden blackout, and I was feeling pretty smug about my stash of flashlights and power banks. As I fumbled around in the dark, I realized I had enough backup light to supply a small concert! My family teased me about being the gloriously over-prepared person, but honestly, I was just happy we could keep the phones charged and the snacks flowing. It's a little reminder that being ready can turn an inconvenience into a cozy family night. What's your favorite way to stay comfy during a power outage?
